steps.objective: Walk to Doc Vega — the TEAL workshop at the south end of Main Street, west side — and press E to say howdy
Find the practice rail beside the general store. Hold Right-click to aim at a green bottle — when the circle turns gold, Left-click to shoot
The hay bale sits on the store porch — hold Right-click to aim at it, then press F to lasso it down
Doc Vega has news about the deeds — press E to talk to her at the teal workshop
Sneak around the BACK of the bank (brown building, north-west end of the street). Stay OUT of the guards' lantern light
Follow the gold arrow: aim at the GOLD LOCK on the strongbox wagon (hold Right-click) and shoot it (Left-click)
Walk up to the open strongbox and press E to take back the forged deeds
Ride! Shoot the THREE targets under gold arrows: the water-tower VALVE up north, the wagon AXLE on the west road, and the crate ROPE on the arch past it. (B whistles Biscuit, H mounts)
Ride WEST past the arch to the campfire and tents at the foot of the mesa — that's home
Newt is hopping up and down near the DEPOT (grey building, east side of the street) — press E to hear him out
Ride EAST along the dirt road to the railhead platform
The pay train is moving! Gallop alongside the BROWN pay car and press E to leap aboard
From the roof: follow the gold arrow, aim at the GOLD COUPLING between the cars ahead and shoot it
When your cars roll to a stop: aim at the SAFE DOOR on the car's side and press F to lasso it clean off
Press E beside the open safe to see what's inside
Press E to hop down off the train
Whistle Biscuit (B) and ride WEST, all the way back to the hideout camp
A very calm stranger is waiting in the middle of Main Street — walk up and press E
Round one: shoot the BOTTLE on the barrel down the street (hold Right-click to aim, Left-click to fire)
Round two: stand near the Kestrel and press E to call the toss — then shoot the COIN at the top of its arc. Tip: hold your aim BEFORE calling it, so the slow-mo is running
Round three: shoot Preacher's FRYING PAN on the post near the chapel — the ricochet handles the rest
Walk back to the Kestrel and press E — settle it like civilised legends
One last plan — press E to talk to Doc Vega at the teal workshop
Ride NORTH up the road, past the water tower, to Vane's big white mansion
Follow the gold arrow: aim at Vane's GOLD STATUE out front and press F to lasso it into the begonias
While they mourn the statue: go to the WINDOW on the east wing (gold arrow), aim at its gold latch and shoot it
Walk to the open window and press E to take Vane's ledger
Someone pompous is blocking your path — press E to face Mr Vane
Ride back to the TRAIN DEPOT in town and press E to hand the ledger to Marshal Reyes
